root_cause: Edit transforms and on_changed were attached to the controller's commit path, so set_text/set_value (programmatic) ran formatters and user callbacks.
change: crates/incular-text/src/editing.rs: update_committed takes a user flag; only editing operations (replace_selection, insert, backspace, delete_*, apply_delta, commit_preedit) run transforms; set_value/set_text store as given. observe_user_edits added, notified only for user edits that change text. crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/reconciliation.rs: sync_edit_callbacks subscribes on_changed via observe_user_edits and drops the mount-time normalization that formatted restored text.
api_change: additive: TextEditingController::observe_user_edits; EditableText::input_formatter; EditableText::on_editing_complete. Behavior change: TextEditingController::set_value/set_text/undo no longer run edit transforms or on_changed.
limitations: Undo/redo apply through set_value and so no longer fire on_changed; Flutter's UndoHistory also sets controller.value, so this matches Flutter but changes Incular behavior. The mount-time normalization of restored text was removed (Flutter does not format restored values).
note: Public editing helpers (insert, backspace, etc.) are treated as user edits, since the runtime keyboard and IME paths call them; an app calling them programmatically gets formatter treatment.

root_cause: TextInputFormatter existed in forms.rs but EditableText had no inputFormatters builder and nothing called format_edit_update.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/descriptors.rs: EditableText::input_formatter(f) appends a formatter; compose_edit_transform folds the formatters in order (old value passed to each), then any raw edit_transform runs last. Applied only on user edits via the controller change in text-006.
harness: text__editable_formatter_length_then_digits / digits_then_length: run 1 diverged because the Incular twin never added formatters; twin updated to use input_formatter in both orders. Rerun pending (Flutter load stalled).
limitations: Only user edits are formatted; the formatter order with a non-empty field is covered by the unit test, not the harness.
note: forms.rs TextInputFormatter section untouched; the fold lives in descriptors.rs.

root_cause: EditableText had only on_submit; no onEditingComplete, and the Enter key called submit directly without Flutter's finalize step.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/descriptors.rs, specs.rs, widget/structure.rs: on_editing_complete builder and spec field. crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/text.rs: submit_text_field runs on_editing_complete then on_submit; text_field_has_editing_complete added. crates/incular-runtime/src/frame.rs: finish_text_editing releases focus before on_submit when no completion callback is set (Flutter _finalizeEditing default), used by Done/Go/Search/Send and single-line Newline. crates/incular-runtime/src/frame/text_actions.rs: desktop Enter routes through the Newline action, the same path as the IME action.
harness: text__editable_enter_callback_order: run 1 showed editing_complete_calls missing on the Incular side; twin now counts on_editing_complete. submitted_calls still differs (Flutter test key does not submit; input-path difference, per finding). Rerun pending.
limitations: Behavior change to confirm: a single-line Enter key on desktop now also releases focus when no on_editing_complete is set, as Flutter's default does. Flutter's test key does not submit, so the scenario's submitted count may still differ.
note: Files outside assignment touched in small ways: specs.rs and widget/structure.rs (one field each), frame/text_actions.rs (Enter branch).

root_cause: The caret paint condition in content.rs did not check for a collapsed selection; Flutter paints the blinking cursor only when the selection is collapsed.
harness: none (frame recorder cannot see caret glyphs); source-only evidence
limitations: No regression test; the paint path is not reachable from the widget test surface without a pixel check.

root_cause: Flutter's TextEditingController(text:) has selection -1/-1 until focus applies _adjustedSelectionWhenFocused (collapsed at the end). Incular's TextSelection has public usize base/extent fields and every edit path clamps into the text.
harness: text__editable_initial_selection_focus and text__editable_multiline_vertical_document: still diverge before focus (-1 vs 12).
api_change: Decided representation (non-breaking): keep TextSelection unchanged and add an unset flag to the controller state in crates/incular-text/src/editing.rs. with_text starts unset; a new selection_if_set() -> Option<TextSelection> returns None while unset; selection() keeps returning the current clamped value for existing callers; any set_selection or edit marks it set; EditableText focus (tree/text.rs set_focused) applies Flutter's collapsed-at-end selection while unset. Twins then read selection_if_set().map_or(-1, ...).
limitations: Deferred: the change belongs in editing.rs, outside this group's files, and needs review with the editing owner.
note: Text residual pass: an Option-returning accessor was chosen over an Option field so no public field changes.

root_cause: EditableText carried a built-in 8 px inset (text width - 16, top 8, height + 16, 32 px minimum). Flutter's EditableText has none: its height is its lines.
change: crates/incular-widgets: new EditableText::content_padding(EdgeInsets), default zero, plumbed through TextFieldSpec/TextFieldRender (specs.rs, tree.rs, rendering/lowering/visual.rs, widget/structure.rs equality). layout/behavior/text.rs uses it for the text width and height and drops the 32 px floor; painting/behavior/content.rs and tree/text.rs use it for caret, glyph transform, selection, viewport, scroll reveal, pointer mapping and the IME caret rect (new text_field_content_top helper). selection_rects no longer adds 8 px, which also removes a stray 8 px shift of static SelectableText highlights. Wrappers keep their visuals: incular-controls text_input.rs TextField (used by TextArea and DocumentEditor) and incular-material TextField set content_padding(8) and wrap the editor in ConstrainedBox(min height 32); incular-material catalog/search.rs sets content_padding(8).
tests: crates/incular-widgets/tests/editable_text_alignment.rs, editable_text_bidi.rs, editable_text_direction.rs, editable_text_paragraph_layout.rs (their inset geometry now comes from an explicit 8 px content_padding)
crates/incular-runtime/tests/text_field_scroll_keys.rs::page_keys_scroll_a_multiline_field_by_eight_tenths_of_its_viewport (the bare viewport is the whole 120 px)
incular-controls controls_test, document_editor, migrated_tests, resize_rebuilds, w7_form_text and incular-material migrated_tests: pass
harness: text__editable_max_lines_sizing: match (was 67 vs 51); text__editable_min_lines_sizing: match (was 50 vs 34); text__editable_expands_sizing still matches.
api_change: Added EditableText::content_padding. Behavior change: a bare EditableText is no longer inset or floored at 32 px. Direct users who want the old look set content_padding(EdgeInsets::all(8.)) and a 32 px minimum height.
limitations: The incular-controls autocomplete, number_field and otp_field editors are invisible overlays filled to their visual and keep no padding; examples/workbench uses the bare editor and now has Flutter sizing.
note: Text residual pass. Out-of-ownership edits: specs.rs, tree.rs, lowering/visual.rs, widget/structure.rs, painting.rs (import), material catalog/search.rs.

root_cause: Two causes. (1) Focus and edits restarted the blink with the wall clock: frame.rs set_focus and the keyboard/IME reset_caret calls, and the text_gestures.rs tap time, used Instant::now() instead of the input event's time, so under a virtual clock the blink phase led Flutter by the real elapsed time (about 16 ms). (2) The Flutter twin read renderEditable.showCursor, which starts as widget.showCursor (true) before focus (editable_text.dart initState) although no caret is painted, so frame 0 differed in the probe, not in behavior.
change: crates/incular-runtime/src/frame.rs: set_focus and the reset_caret calls use self.input_now(); crates/incular-runtime/src/frame/text_gestures.rs: tap and double-tap times and the menu-intent reset use self.input_now(). harness/flutter/test/frames/text_test.dart: the caret_blink twin reads state.cursorCurrentlyVisible (blink opacity > 0).
harness: text__editable_caret_blink_1200ms: match (caret on at focus, off at 528 ms, on at 1024 ms in both).
limitations: Outside an input dispatch input_now() falls back to Instant::now(), as before. The Flutter twin was changed because its probe was proven wrong.
note: Text residual pass. Out-of-ownership edits: incular-runtime frame.rs and frame/text_gestures.rs.
